title: cairn site settings
description: Site chrome: title, languages, welcome note, links, hosted pages, status. Docs: https://github.com/MorganKryze/cairn/blob/main/docs/configuration/site.md

title.description: The site name, shown in the header and the tab. Plain text or a per-locale mapping.

tagline.description: One sentence describing the site, translatable.

url.description: Public base URL (https://…). Enables canonical links, hreflang and an absolute sitemap.

logo.description: Image shown before the title: URL or /assets path. A raster logo also becomes the social preview image when url is set.

favicon.description: Tab icon: URL or /assets path. Defaults to cairn's own.

icons.description: Home-screen icons, for "add to home screen" and the browser install prompt. Supply them yourself when you want the full set: cairn never resizes an image. Omit this and the icons are derived from favicon, or are cairn's own.

src.description: URL or /assets path to the image.

sizes.description: Its real size, like "512x512", or "any" for an svg. Chromium offers to install a site only when a 192 and a 512 are both present.

purpose.description: any, maskable or monochrome; they may be combined, as in "any maskable". A maskable icon must keep its content inside the middle 80%, because Android crops the rest.

index.description: false asks search engines to stay away: robots.txt disallows, pages carry noindex, the sitemap turns off.

locales.description: Enabled languages; the first is the default. Codes like fr, en, pt-BR.

accent.description: The accent color, a hex value like "#247b7b".

about.description: Dismissable welcome note on the home page, translatable. Long text: paragraphs and CommonMark, minus raw HTML.

icon.description: A built-in glyph (book, chat, github, globe, heart, home, key, mail, portfolio, rss, status, user), a URL, or an /assets path.

footer.description: Footer links, before the hosted pages.

pages.description: Pages cairn serves itself (legal notice, privacy…), linked in the footer.

body.description: Intro text. Long text: paragraphs and CommonMark, minus raw HTML. The page title is the h1, so start headings here at ##.

credit.description: false removes the footer "powered by cairn".

show_version.description: true prints the running cairn version beside the credit: the release number for a tagged build, the commit for a build off main. Off by default.

strings.description: Overrides for built-in UI strings, keyed like search.placeholder.

contact.description: Where to report a vulnerability, as a URI: mailto:security@example.org, https://example.org/report, tel:+33.... Setting it is what makes cairn serve /.well-known/security.txt.

policy.description: URL of your disclosure policy, if you publish one.

encryption.description: URL of the public key a reporter should encrypt to.

gatus.description: Gatus base URL cairn polls for the status pills.

page.description: Public Gatus URL the pills link to; set it when the poll URL is internal.

interval.description: Poll cadence, a duration of at least 5s (e.g. 60s). Also how often a page already open in a browser refreshes its pills.

insecure.description: true stops cairn verifying the certificate Gatus presents, for an internal Gatus whose authority nothing public signed. A CA bundle verifies instead of trusting; this only turns the check off. cairn logs it at startup and cairn -check warns about it every run.

linked.description: false makes the pills display-only: they still show up, down or unknown, but they stop linking to the status page. For a Gatus your visitors cannot reach.
